senses.gloss: पूजा- + अर्ह पूजा- + अर्ह, adj. worthy of reverence, Man. 9, 26.

पूज् पूज्, i. 10, Par. (also Ātm., Hit. ii. d. 36, and in epic poetry, i. 1, MBh. 3, 1005).
 1. To honour, to reverence, MBh. 1, 6038; Pañc. i. d. 146 (Ātm.).
 2. To regard, Yājñ. 2, 14. (Ptcple. of the pf. pass. Anomalous potential पूजयीत, MBh. 3, 1070). पूजित,
 1. Frequented, Arj. 4, 55.
 2. Recommended.
 3. Acknowledged, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3174.
 4. Endowed, Rām. 2, 26, 16.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To honour one after the other, Rām. 2, 99, 9 Gorr.
 --With अभि अभि,
 1. To honour, Rām. 1, 1, 83.
 2. To value highly, MBh. 1, 17.
 3. To approve, Rām. 2, 76, 12. अभिपूजित,
 1. Offered after humble reverences, Man. 6, 58(?).
 2. Agreeable, Rām. 1, 52, 23.
 --With समभि सम्-अभि, To honour, MBh. 4, 98.
 --With परि परि, To honour much, Śiś. 1, 14.
 --With संपरि सम्-परि, The same, MBh. 13, 2110.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To honour especially, Pañc. i. d. 164; MBh. 6, 3790 (प्रपूजिरे without reduplication; probably it is to be changed to पुपूजिरे); 13, 914.
 2. To approve, MBh. 8, 3244.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To show honour, Hariv. 16223.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To return a salutation, Rām. 1, 26, 4.
 2. To salute in one's turn, Man. 1, 1.
 3. To approve, Rām. 1, 11, 10.
 4. To honour, Man. 3, 58.
 --With संप्रति सम्-प्रति, To honour, to salute with reverence, Rām. 2, 70, 6.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To honour, Man. 2, 210.
 2. To esteem highly, MBh. 3, 1110.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, To honour, MBh. 1, 6376.
पूजक पूज् + अक, adj., f. जिका, Worshipping, [] MBh. 2, 454; honouring, a worshipper.

पूजन पूज् + अन,
 I. n. Honouring, worshipping, Man. 4, 152.
 II. f. नी, The name of a female bird (in a legend).
 --Comp.
पूजयितृ पूजयितृ, i. e. पूज्, Caus., + तृ, m., f. त्री, and n. Worshipping, a worshipper, MBh. 13, 7517.

पूजा पूज् + आ, f., Worshipping, honouring, respect, adoration, Kathās. 4, 43; Vikr. 45, 18.
 --Comp.
पूज्यता पूज्य + ता (vb. पूज्), f., and पूज्यत्व पूज्य + त्व, n. Venerableness, MBh. 2, 1386.
